column3: NKJV adds “Like” and “springing,” and rearranges the lines so the grass comes before “by clear shining after rain”; the Hebrew is terse and its meaning is uncertain.
NKJV renders the opening as a concession, “Although my house is not so with God”; the Hebrew can be read as a question, “Is not my house so with God?”
Close to the Hebrew; “worthlessness” (Belial) is rendered “the sons of rebellion.”
The Hebrew is obscure; NKJV renders “chief of the three” as “chief among the captains,” and supplies “He was called” and “because he had killed.”
Close to the Hebrew; “the men of Israel went up” is rendered “had retreated.”
NKJV renders לַחַיָּה (“to Lehi” or “into a troop”) as “into a troop.”
NKJV has “chief of another three,” where the Hebrew reads “chief of the three.”
